title: cortia candollei
intro: Cortia candollei, commonly known as the Himalayan Buttonbush or Himalayan Button Flower, is a plant species belonging to the family Rutaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, contributing to its potential health benefits such as wound healing, reduced fever, and relief from respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cortia candollei include its antioxidant, analgesic, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids.
